{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-high-fresh0/frozen/seen-reference/play/users/u010/system/state/workspace/programs/task-def73f3e.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Full uniform rows/columns in a non-background color are panel separators.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    row_parts = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1)]
    col_parts = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds)-1)]
    # Select the panel containing the most non-background content, then tile it into every panel.
    panels = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_parts):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_parts):
            tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
            score = sum(v != bg for row in tile for v in row)
            panels.append((score, ri, ci, tile))
    _, sri, sci, source = max(panels, key=lambda p: (p[0], -p[1], -p[2]))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_parts):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_parts):
            if ri == sri and ci == sci:
                continue
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    out[r][c] = source[(r-r0) % len(source)][(c-c0) % len(source[0])]
    return out
